semanticDecisions: switch rule compares retained primitive bytes: n mappings stay sparse while M3IntLongHashMap.payloadBytesFor(max(1,n)) < dense payload (values + presence words); directSwitchSize() is the smallest n for which the dense lane is chosen (21 for a 70-constant enum, 0 for a 3-constant enum)
insertion migrates sparse-to-dense when size+1 reaches the switch; removal and clear never migrate; compact() re-applies the rule in both directions and shrinks a sparse table
ordinal iteration order in both modes: sparse traversal probes ordinals 0..keyCapacity-1 (allocation-free); forEach/keys in sparse mode take one enum universe copy per call instead of retaining it

key contract as M3EnumLongMap: put(null) NullPointerException, foreign constant ClassCastException on put/putIfAbsent/getAsLong, absent on containsKey/getOrDefault/remove/removeKey; expectedSize outside 0..keyCapacity is IllegalArgumentException
retained fields: Class, int domainSize, the active M3IntLongHashMap or M3EnumLongMap (the other null); no per-mapping object
